skip_rule_path.note: v2 澄清：专项与通用取更严，v1不以专项许可代替通用心代谢疾病许可或跳过实际症状阻断。

value.trigger: a main slot pattern repeats from the previous calendar day

value.assign_order: fill rt sessions on user-chosen weekdays maximizing min gap; then aerobic/mobility on remaining chosen days

value.recalibrate_method: replace defaults with user's median logged set, rest and transition times

value.over_cap_action: move excess sets to CN1 or CD1 time

value.match: mobility exercises whose bodyPart or primaryMuscles overlap today's main and accessory slots

bodyweight_main.method: ladder step -1, or same exercise at 50% of target reps

fallback_order: swap the second member with the next unused day position that forms an allowed pair (core_1, core_2 first)
run both as straight sets with dose.rest.table

value.priority_when_time_short: muscles trained in M1, M2, M3 first

steps: subtract warm-up and cool-down time from session minutes
allocate main slots (M*) first using session.time.model
fill superset/accessory slots in template order until time runs out
if estimated time exceeds budget by >2 min: remove rounds from last accessory slot, then drop that slot

value.resolve: start/max = goal range clipped by level floor/ceiling; start_moving may go below level floor

value.split_rule: if weekly target exceeds cap * exposures, add exposure (week.frequency.per_muscle)

value.loadable_first_exposure: choose load the user expects to lift for rep_max + 3 reps (≈RIR 3)

first_set_check.action: count as warm-up set, +10% next set

value.list_pattern_slot: try patterns in listed order; first non-empty wins

sort_keys_in_order: main slots: laterality == bilateral first; nsca_class == compound first

value.within_rank: difficulty desc (higher technique first), then template slot order

on_below_min: add 1 set to existing pull accessory
swap last push accessory for pull_horizontal

value.on_out_of_range: move 1 accessory set between hinge and lunge slots

on_empty_candidate_list: use adjacent pattern: squat<->lunge, push_horizontal<->push_vertical, pull_horizontal<->pull_vertical, anti_* among themselves
leave slot empty and give its time to the next slot; log coverage gap

value.condition: no catalog exercise with primary_pattern in [pull_horizontal, pull_vertical] passes filters for the user's equipment
value.catalog_note: v0.1 catalog has 0 pull exercises with equipment none; band pulls: band-pull-apart (warmup/accessory), band-assisted-pull-ups (needs pull-up-bar)
actions: fill pull slots with: band pull if available, else secondary-pattern pull, else next unused core_or_hinge position
keep push volume at goal start value (no weekly ramp on push) while gap persists
show equipment.pull_gap_copy once per week until equipment updated, max 4 times
value.clear_when: user_adds_equipment_in [resistance-band, loop-band, pull-up-bar, suspension-trainer, dumbbell, kettlebell]

value.trigger: goal == strength and no loadable lower-body equipment

value.check: per pattern, count exercises with equipment in [none, resistance-band, loop-band] and use ∋ main|accessory

value.deviation: logged_rir - target_rir_max if logged > max; logged_rir - target_rir_min if logged < min; else 0

value.performance_improved: ≥1 exercise gained reps or load and no exercise regressed

three_sessions_path.note: v2 澄清：v1不以自我声明或缺失历史放行第三课；保留两次力量训练，待完整首周与DOMS证据链后启用。

stop_exercise.zh: 这个动作先停一下，我们换一个更舒服的版本。
stop_exercise.en: Let's stop this one and switch to a version that feels better.

drop_pattern.zh: 本次和下次训练先不安排这类动作
drop_pattern.en: We will leave this type of movement out of this workout and the next one.

referral.zh: 这个部位已经第二次明显不舒服了。建议你找医生或物理治疗师看一看，确认之后再继续加量。
referral.en: This is the second time this area has flared up. Please check in with a doctor or physiotherapist before we increase your training again.

shorter_range.zh: 幅度小一点通常更舒服，按你觉得舒适的深度来做就好。
shorter_range.en: A shorter range is often more comfortable. Go only as deep as feels okay.

rom_restore_step.note: v1 不实现：缺少测量基准与真实记录

prompt_medical.zh: 你提到的情况需要先请医生看一看。训练计划先暂停，请尽快预约就诊。看过医生后回到这里确认，我们会从轻松的内容重新开始。
prompt_medical.en: What you've described needs a doctor's opinion first. Your plan is paused. Please book an appointment soon, then come back and confirm, and we'll restart gently.

emergency_back.zh: 腹股沟或臀部周围发麻、新出现的大小便控制问题，或腿越来越没力气，需要立即去急诊。请不要等待。
emergency_back.en: Numbness around the groin or buttocks, new bladder or bowel problems, or legs getting weaker need emergency care now. Please don't wait.

cardiac.zh: 请立即停止运动并坐下休息。如果胸口不适或呼吸困难在休息后几分钟内没有缓解，请马上拨打当地急救电话。
cardiac.en: Stop now and sit down. If chest discomfort or breathlessness doesn't ease within a few minutes of rest, call emergency services.

paused_banner.zh: 训练计划已暂停，等你确认看过医生后再继续。
paused_banner.en: Your plan is paused until you confirm you've seen a health professional.

substituted.zh: 已为你换成对这个部位更友好的版本。
substituted.en: We've swapped in a version that's easier on this area.

back_keep_moving.zh: 保持活动通常比完全休息更有帮助。今天的动作已为你调整过。
back_keep_moving.en: Staying active usually helps more than complete rest. Today's moves have been adjusted for you.

wrist_neutral.zh: 这个动作请握住哑铃或俯卧撑支架来做，让手腕保持笔直。
wrist_neutral.en: Hold dumbbells or push-up handles for this one so your wrists stay straight.

comfortable_box_height.en: Sit down to a comfortable height.

partial_range_or_tempo.zh: 部分幅度或慢节奏自重深蹲
partial_range_or_tempo.en: Bodyweight squats with a partial range or a slow tempo.

limited_range.en: Leg press with a limited range of motion.

neutral_grip.en: Dumbbell bench press with a neutral grip.

reduced_depth.zh: 减小幅度的上斜俯卧撑
reduced_depth.en: Incline push-ups with a reduced range of motion.

intro.zh: 为了把平衡练习安排得更稳妥，想先问你 4 个简单的问题。
intro.en: To set up your balance work safely, we have 4 quick questions.

fell_in_past_12_months.zh: 过去 12 个月里，你摔倒过吗？
fell_in_past_12_months.en: Have you had a fall in the past 12 months?

afraid_of_falling.zh: 你平时会担心自己摔倒吗？

frequent_dizziness.zh: 你经常感到头晕或站不稳吗？
frequent_dizziness.en: Do you often feel dizzy or unsteady?

uses_walking_aid.zh: 你平时走路会用手杖、助行器等辅助工具吗？
uses_walking_aid.en: Do you use a stick, frame or other walking aid?

any_yes_result.zh: 谢谢。我们会从有扶手支撑的平衡练习开始，一步步来。
any_yes_result.en: Thanks. We'll start your balance work with something to hold on to and build up step by step.

before_floor_block.zh: 接下来几个动作在垫子上做。请扶着椅子慢慢下去，做完再扶着椅子慢慢起来，不用着急。
before_floor_block.en: The next few moves are on the mat. Use a chair to lower yourself down slowly, and use it again to get up when you're done. Take your time.

stand_up_slowly.zh: 起身后先站稳几秒，没有头晕再继续。
stand_up_slowly.en: Once you're up, stand still for a few seconds and carry on only if you don't feel dizzy.

copy.zh: 骨质疏松或骨折史需要专业人士帮你判断适合的负荷。在你确认已咨询医生或物理治疗师之前，我们会先避开负重弯腰、负重扭转、大重量和跳跃类动作。
copy.en: With osteoporosis or a past fracture, a health professional should advise on suitable loads. Until you confirm you've spoken to a doctor or physiotherapist, we'll leave out loaded bending, loaded twisting, heavy lifts and jumping.

cardiac.zh: 如果你感到胸口疼或发紧、异常气喘、头晕想晕倒，或者心跳很快、不规律，请马上停下来坐好，并尽快就医。如果休息几分钟后仍没有缓解，请立即拨打急救电话。
cardiac.en: If you feel chest pain or tightness, unusual breathlessness, dizziness or faintness, or a racing or irregular heartbeat, stop now, sit down and seek medical advice. If it doesn't ease after a few minutes' rest, call emergency services.

fall_injury.zh: 摔倒时撞到了头，或者站起来后腿不能用力，请尽快就医。训练计划先暂停，等你确认看过医生后再继续。
fall_injury.en: If you hit your head when you fell, or you can't put weight on your leg, please get medical advice soon. Your plan is paused until you confirm you've been checked.

fall_no_injury.zh: 今天的训练先到这里，好好休息。下次我们会把平衡练习调得更稳一些。
fall_no_injury.en: Let's stop here for today and rest. Next time we'll make the balance work a bit steadier.

intro.zh: 孕期保持活动对大多数准妈妈有好处。不过有些情况需要先听医生或助产士的意见，所以先请你确认几件事。
intro.en: Staying active is good for most pregnant women. Some situations need your doctor's or midwife's advice first, so please confirm a few things.

provider_question.zh: 你的产检医生或助产士有没有说过你不适合运动？
provider_question.en: Has your doctor or midwife told you not to exercise?

prenatal_checkups_question.zh: 你现在在定期做产检吗？
prenatal_checkups_question.en: Are you having regular prenatal check-ups?

absolute_list_zh: 破水，或者有液体从阴道流出
出现早产迹象（还没到预产期就有规律宫缩）
原因不明、持续不断的阴道出血
孕 26 周以后，医生说胎盘位置偏低（前置胎盘）
医生说你的宫颈机能不全
医生说宝宝生长偏慢（胎儿生长受限）
没有控制好的 1 型糖尿病、高血压或甲状腺疾病
其他严重的心脏、肺部或全身性疾病
absolute_list_en: Your waters have broken, or fluid is leaking from your vagina
Unexplained vaginal bleeding that keeps happening
Your doctor has said your cervix is weak (incompetent cervix)
Your doctor has said your baby is not growing as expected
Type 1 diabetes, high blood pressure or thyroid disease that isn't under control
Another serious heart, lung or whole-body condition
relative_list_zh: 孕期血压升高（妊娠期高血压）
轻到中度的心脏或肺部疾病
有症状的贫血（比如经常乏力、头晕）
孕 28 周以后的双胎妊娠
骨骼或关节方面的限制
relative_list_en: High blood pressure in pregnancy (gestational hypertension)
Mild or moderate heart or lung disease
Anaemia with symptoms such as tiredness or dizziness
Very low or very high body weight
An irregular heartbeat that hasn't been checked

ask_provider.zh: 请先在产检时和医生或助产士聊聊运动的事，确认后回来告诉我们，我们再为你安排。
ask_provider.en: Please talk to your doctor or midwife about exercise at a prenatal check-up first. Come back once you have, and we’ll set up your plan.

absolute_yes.zh: 根据你的回答，现在不适合由我们为你安排训练。请和你的产检医生或助产士谈一谈，听取适合你的建议。
absolute_yes.en: Based on your answers, we can't set up a training plan for you right now. Please talk to your doctor or midwife about what's right for you.

relative_yes.zh: 你提到的情况需要医生或助产士先确认你可以运动。确认后回来告诉我们，我们再为你安排。
relative_yes.en: What you've mentioned needs your doctor or midwife to confirm exercise is okay. Let us know once they have, and we'll set up your plan.

app_limit.zh: 我们无法判断你的具体情况是否适合运动。到孕 13 周和 28 周时，我们会再请你确认一次。
app_limit.en: We can't judge whether your situation is suitable for exercise. We'll ask you to confirm again at 13 and 28 weeks.

copy.zh: 平躺时如果觉得头晕、恶心或不舒服，请马上换成侧躺或坐姿。之后我们不再安排平躺的动作。
copy.en: If lying on your back makes you feel lightheaded, sick or unwell, switch to lying on your side or sitting up. We won't schedule lying-on-your-back moves from now on.

static_standing.note: 静态站立保持类；不适用于步行、踏步等动态有氧。

copy.zh: 今天别忘了做盆底肌练习。如果还不确定怎么做，可以请产检医生、助产士或盆底物理治疗师教你。
copy.en: Remember your pelvic floor exercises today. If you're not sure how to do them, ask your doctor, midwife or a pelvic health physiotherapist to show you.

heat.zh: 天气炎热或潮湿时，请选择凉爽通风的地方运动，穿宽松透气的衣服，随时补水。觉得太热或不舒服就停下来休息。
heat.en: In hot or humid weather, exercise somewhere cool and well ventilated, wear loose, breathable clothing, and drink regularly. If you feel too hot or unwell, stop and rest.

altitude.zh: 在还没适应的高海拔地区（约 1,800 米以上），请不要做剧烈运动。
altitude.en: Avoid strenuous exercise above about 1,800 metres if you’re not used to the altitude.

stop.zh: 请现在停止运动，并联系你的产检医生或助产士，如果你出现：阴道出血、有液体流出、规律的疼痛宫缩、胸痛、头晕或要晕倒、运动前就呼吸费力或休息后仍气喘、头痛、小腿疼痛或肿胀、腹痛，或者腿没力气、站不稳。
stop.en: Stop exercising now and contact your doctor or midwife if you have vaginal bleeding, fluid leaking, regular painful contractions, chest pain, dizziness or feeling faint, breathlessness before exercise or that doesn't ease afterwards, a headache, calf pain or swelling, tummy pain, or weakness that affects your balance.

chest_emergency.zh: 如果胸痛或呼吸困难在休息几分钟后仍没有缓解，请立即拨打急救电话。
chest_emergency.en: If chest pain or breathlessness doesn't ease after a few minutes' rest, call emergency services now.

paused.zh: 训练计划先暂停。联系过医生或助产士后回来确认，你的计划会一直保留。
paused.en: Your plan is paused. Once you've spoken to your doctor or midwife, come back and confirm. Your plan will be waiting.

copy.zh: 这次训练超过 45 分钟，运动前记得吃点东西，过程中随时补水。
copy.en: This session is over 45 minutes. Have a snack beforehand and keep sipping water as you go.

copy.zh: 恭喜你！在正式开始训练前，请先和医生或助产士确认身体恢复情况（通常在产后 6–8 周的复查时）。在那之前，我们只安排步行、盆底肌提醒和轻柔的活动。
copy.en: Congratulations! Before starting training, please check your recovery with your doctor or midwife, usually at your 6–8 week postnatal check. Until then, we'll keep to walking, pelvic floor reminders and gentle movement.

ask_copy.zh: 产后复查时，医生或助产士是否已经确认你可以开始运动？
ask_copy.en: At your postnatal check, did your doctor or midwife confirm you can start exercising?

intro.zh: 想恢复跑步和跳跃？先做下面这几项自测。每一项都要做到不痛、没有下坠或沉重感、没有漏尿，才算通过。
intro.en: Want to get back to running and jumping? Try these self-checks first. Each one counts only if there's no pain, no heaviness or dragging, and no leaking.

items_zh: 交替跨步跳（running man）10 次（每侧）
items_en: Stand on one leg for 10 seconds (each side)
Jog on the spot for 1 minute
Hop on one leg 10 times (each side)

pass.zh: 全部通过了，可以开始循序渐进地恢复跑步。大多数人在产后 3–6 个月回到跑步。
pass.en: You've passed every check, so you can start easing back into running. Most women return to running 3–6 months after birth.

fail.zh: 有一项还没通过也很正常。我们先继续力量和低冲击训练，2 周后再试。也可以请盆底物理治疗师帮你看一看。
fail.en: It's normal not to pass every check yet. We'll keep going with strength and low-impact work and try again in 2 weeks. A pelvic health physiotherapist can also help.

tip.zh: 如果你在哺乳，运动前先喂奶或吸奶会更舒服。运动一般不会影响奶量。运动前也记得喝水。
tip.en: If you're breastfeeding, feeding or expressing before exercise can feel more comfortable. Exercise doesn't usually affect milk supply. Remember to drink some water before you start, too.

copy.zh: 做腹部动作时如果肚子中间鼓起来，我们先换成更温和的版本，用力时记得呼气。也可以请盆底物理治疗师看一看。
copy.en: If the middle of your tummy bulges during ab exercises, we'll switch to gentler versions. Breathe out as you push. A pelvic health physiotherapist can also take a look.

warning.zh: 漏尿、下坠或沉重感、盆腔或腹部疼痛，或者出血又出现或一直不停，都不是需要硬撑的情况。先暂停跑跳和大重量，并和你的全科医生、助产士或盆底物理治疗师谈一谈。
warning.en: Leaking, a feeling of heaviness or dragging, pelvic or tummy pain, or bleeding that comes back or won't stop aren't things to push through. Pause running, jumping and heavy lifting, and speak to your GP, midwife or a pelvic health physiotherapist.

regressed.zh: 我们已把计划调回上一阶段。等你看过专业人士，或连续 2 周没有这些症状，再继续往前。
regressed.en: We've moved your plan back a stage. We'll move forward again once you've seen a professional or had 2 weeks without these symptoms.

urgent.zh: 大量出血、发烧、伤口红肿发热或渗液、小腿疼痛或肿胀、胸痛或呼吸困难，请尽快就医，不要等待。
urgent.en: Heavy bleeding, a fever, a wound that's hot, red or oozing, calf pain or swelling, chest pain or breathlessness need prompt medical care. Please don't wait.

chest_emergency.zh: 如果胸痛或呼吸困难在休息几分钟后仍没有缓解，请立即拨打急救电话。
chest_emergency.en: If chest pain or breathlessness doesn't ease after a few minutes' rest, call emergency services now.

paused.zh: 训练计划已暂停，等你确认看过医生后再继续。
paused.en: Your plan is paused until you confirm you've seen a doctor.

copy.zh: 今天记得做盆底肌练习。如果不确定动作对不对，或者有漏尿，请找助产士或盆底物理治疗师帮忙。
copy.en: Remember your pelvic floor exercises today. If you're not sure you're doing them right, or you have any leaking, ask a midwife or pelvic health physiotherapist.

offer.zh: 产后 6 周起，可以考虑请盆底物理治疗师做一次评估，帮你更放心地恢复训练。
offer.en: From 6 weeks after birth, you might consider a pelvic health physiotherapy assessment to help you return to exercise with confidence.

safety.copy.under_18.zh: 本应用的训练计划只面向 18 岁及以上的成年人。未满 18 岁的朋友，建议在体育老师、教练或家长的指导下参加适合你年龄的运动。
safety.copy.under_18.en: Our training plans are designed for adults aged 18 and over. If you're under 18, please exercise with guidance from a PE teacher, coach or parent.

safety.copy.clearance_needed.zh: 根据你的回答，开始（或加大）运动前，建议先咨询医生或合格的运动专业人员。这不代表你不能运动——大多数人在专业人士确认后都可以安全地动起来。确认后回到这里，我们会为你安排合适的计划。
safety.copy.clearance_needed.en: Based on your answers, please check with a doctor or qualified exercise professional before starting or stepping up exercise. This doesn't mean you can't be active—most people can exercise safely once they've been checked. Come back after that and we'll set up a suitable plan.

safety.copy.illness_pause.zh: 身体不舒服时先好好休息。等感觉恢复了再告诉我们，我们会帮你从合适的强度重新开始。
safety.copy.illness_pause.en: Rest up while you're unwell. Let us know when you feel better and we'll help you restart at the right level.

safety.copy.age45_advisory.zh: 接下来的训练强度较高。如果你 45 岁以上、平时很少做这么累的运动，建议先咨询医生或合格的运动专业人员。确认没问题后再继续；感觉不对随时停下。
safety.copy.age45_advisory.en: The next session is high intensity. If you're over 45 and not used to exercise this hard, we recommend checking with a doctor or qualified exercise professional first. Continue once you're comfortable, and stop any time something feels wrong.

safety.copy.stop_symptoms.zh: 出现以下任何情况，请立即停止训练：胸口发紧、压迫、疼痛或胀满感；疼痛放射到手臂、背部、颈部、下颌或上腹；与用力程度不相称的气短；头晕、眼前发黑或快要晕倒；心慌、心跳不规律或漏跳感；出冷汗或恶心。
safety.copy.stop_symptoms.en: Stop exercising right away if you notice: chest tightness, pressure, pain or fullness; pain spreading to your arm, back, neck, jaw or stomach; shortness of breath out of proportion to the effort; dizziness, light-headedness or feeling faint; a racing, irregular or skipping heartbeat; a cold sweat or nausea.

safety.copy.stop_emergency.zh: 请立即停止运动，坐下或躺下休息。如果胸部不适持续超过几分钟、休息后不缓解，或出现晕倒，请马上拨打急救电话（中国大陆 120）。在医生确认之前，我们会暂停你的训练计划。
safety.copy.stop_emergency.en: Stop exercising now and sit or lie down. If chest discomfort lasts more than a few minutes, doesn't ease with rest, or you faint, call your local emergency number right away. We'll pause your training plan until a doctor has checked you.

safety.copy.disclaimer.zh: 运动对绝大多数人是安全的，好处远大于风险。本应用提供一般健身指导，不是医疗器械，不能诊断或治疗任何疾病，也不能代替医生的意见。
safety.copy.disclaimer.en: Exercise is safe for most people, and the benefits far outweigh the risks. This app offers general fitness guidance. It is not a medical device, can't diagnose or treat any condition, and doesn't replace advice from your doctor.

safety.copy.cmr_chest_neck_jaw_arm_pain_.zh: 胸部、颈部、下颌或手臂的疼痛或不适
safety.copy.cmr_chest_neck_jaw_arm_pain_.en: Pain or discomfort in the chest, neck, jaw or arms

safety.copy.screening_required.zh: 请先完成运动前自查，再生成训练计划。
safety.copy.screening_required.en: Complete the pre-exercise screening before generating a training plan.

safety.copy.cmr_dyspnea_at_rest_or_mild_.zh: 休息或轻微用力时异常气短
safety.copy.cmr_dyspnea_at_rest_or_mild_.en: Unusual breathlessness at rest or with mild exertion

safety.copy.cmr_orthopnea_or_nocturnal_d.zh: 平躺时气短或夜间憋醒
safety.copy.cmr_orthopnea_or_nocturnal_d.en: Breathlessness when lying down or waking at night short of breath

safety.copy.cmr_intermittent_claudicatio.zh: 走路时小腿疼、休息后缓解
safety.copy.cmr_intermittent_claudicatio.en: Calf pain when walking that eases with rest

safety.copy.cmr_unusual_fatigue_or_breat.zh: 日常活动中异常疲劳或气短
safety.copy.cmr_unusual_fatigue_or_breat.en: Unusual fatigue or breathlessness during usual daily activity

goal.fat_loss.copy_spot_reduction.zh: 脂肪从哪里减掉没法自己挑。核心训练让你更有力量；整体活动量和饮食才决定减脂。
goal.fat_loss.copy_spot_reduction.en: You can't choose where fat comes off. Core work builds strength; overall activity and nutrition reduce fat.

goal.fat_loss.copy_expectation.zh: 平均来看，每周多 30 分钟有氧，体重约多降 0.5 公斤；配合饮食调整效果更明显。
goal.fat_loss.copy_expectation.en: On average, each extra 30 min/week of aerobic exercise adds about 0.5 kg of weight loss, more alongside your nutrition.

goal.start_moving.copy_intro.zh: 每一分钟都算数。从你现在能做到的开始，我们一点点往上加。
goal.start_moving.copy_intro.en: Every minute counts. Start where you are, and we'll build up a little at a time.

week.one_day.copy.zh: 每周 1 次力量训练也有用。如果可以，再加一天，或者每天做 2 次 5 分钟的小练习、多走走路，效果会更好。
week.one_day.copy.en: One strength session a week still helps. If you can, add a second day, or do two 5-minute exercise snacks a day and walk more.

dose.power.copy.speed_stop.zh: 发力时速度明显变慢就停下这一组，宁可轻一点、快一点。
dose.power.copy.speed_stop.en: Stop the set when your speed clearly slows down. Lighter and faster beats heavier and slower.

equipment.pull_gap_copy.zh: 没有器械时，"拉"类动作（练背）很难安排。一根带门扣的弹力带就能补上划船和下拉，效果和器械训练相近。要添加到你的器材清单吗？
equipment.pull_gap_copy.en: Without equipment, it's hard to train pulling (your back). A resistance band with a door anchor covers rows and pulldowns, with results similar to machines. Add one to your equipment list?

equipment.strength_bodyweight_copy.zh: 只用自重练腿，力量进步可能较早停滞。我们会用单腿动作、放慢节奏和接近力竭的高次数来继续加难度；有条件时加一对哑铃或壶铃会更好。
equipment.strength_bodyweight_copy.en: With bodyweight only, leg strength may plateau sooner. We'll keep progressing with single-leg moves, slower tempo and high reps near failure; adding dumbbells or a kettlebell will help.

deload.copy.checkin.0.zh: 今天的精力和训练意愿怎么样？（1 很差 – 5 很好）
deload.copy.checkin.0.en: How are your energy and motivation today? (1 very low – 5 very high)

deload.copy.checkin.1.zh: 上次训练后，有几晚没睡好？
deload.copy.checkin.1.en: Since your last workout, how many nights did you sleep badly?

deload.copy.checkin.2.zh: 上次训练的肌肉酸痛消了吗？
deload.copy.checkin.2.en: Has the muscle soreness from your last workout gone?

deload.copy.checkin.3.zh: 有没有新出现或变得更重的关节疼痛？
deload.copy.checkin.3.en: Do you have any new or worse joint pain?

progression.doms.copy.zh: 训练后一两天肌肉酸痛很常见，通常几天内会减轻。轻松走走、正常活动往往有帮助。
progression.doms.copy.en: Muscle soreness a day or two after training is common and usually eases within a few days. Light walking and normal activity often help.

progression.doms.referral.zh: 如果肌肉肿得厉害、尿色变得很深（像浓茶或可乐），或者酸痛剧烈、明显没力气，请先停止训练，今天就去医院看看。确认看过医生后再回来继续。
progression.doms.referral.en: If your muscles are badly swollen, your urine turns very dark (like strong tea or cola), or the soreness is severe with clear weakness, stop training and see a doctor today. Come back once you have been checked.

aerobic.copy.every_minute.zh: 每一分钟都算数。从你现在的水平开始，一点点加量就好。
aerobic.copy.every_minute.en: Every minute counts. Start where you are and build up a little at a time.

aerobic.intensity.talk_test.moderate.en: You can talk, but not sing.

aerobic.intensity.talk_test.vigorous.zh: 只能一次说几个词，就得停下换气。
aerobic.intensity.talk_test.vigorous.en: You can only say a few words before pausing for breath.

fatloss.expectation.copy.zh: 在只增加有氧运动的研究里，平均每周多做 30 分钟，体重约多减 0.5 kg、腰围约少 0.5 cm；每周 150 分钟平均约减 2.8 kg，300 分钟约减 4.2 kg。饮食对减重的作用更大，每个人差别也很大。即使体重没变，运动对健康的好处依然存在。
fatloss.expectation.copy.en: In studies that added aerobic exercise alone, each extra 30 minutes a week led to about 0.5 kg more weight loss and about 0.5 cm off the waist on average; 150 minutes a week averaged about 2.8 kg and 300 minutes about 4.2 kg. Diet plays a bigger role, and results vary a lot between people. Even if your weight doesn't change, exercise still benefits your health.

fatloss.copy.spot_reduction.zh: 脂肪从哪里减少，我们没法自己选。练核心能让你更有力量；全身活动量加上饮食调整，才会让脂肪减少。
fatloss.copy.spot_reduction.en: You can't choose where fat comes off. Core training builds strength; overall activity plus your eating habits is what reduces fat.

pain.copy.stop_exercise.zh: 这个动作先停一下，我们换一个更舒服的版本。
pain.copy.stop_exercise.en: Let's stop this one and switch to a version that feels better.

pain.copy.drop_pattern.zh: 本次和下次训练先不安排这类动作
pain.copy.drop_pattern.en: We will leave this type of movement out of this workout and the next one.

pain.copy.referral.zh: 这个部位已经第二次明显不舒服了。建议你找医生或物理治疗师看一看，确认之后再继续加量。
pain.copy.referral.en: This is the second time this area has flared up. Please check in with a doctor or physiotherapist before we increase your training again.

pain.copy.shorter_range.zh: 幅度小一点通常更舒服，按你觉得舒适的深度来做就好。
pain.copy.shorter_range.en: A shorter range is often more comfortable. Go only as deep as feels okay.

redflag.copy.prompt_medical.zh: 你提到的情况需要先请医生看一看。训练计划先暂停，请尽快预约就诊。看过医生后回到这里确认，我们会从轻松的内容重新开始。
redflag.copy.prompt_medical.en: What you've described needs a doctor's opinion first. Your plan is paused. Please book an appointment soon, then come back and confirm, and we'll restart gently.

redflag.copy.emergency_back.zh: 腹股沟或臀部周围发麻、新出现的大小便控制问题，或腿越来越没力气，需要立即去急诊。请不要等待。
redflag.copy.emergency_back.en: Numbness around the groin or buttocks, new bladder or bowel problems, or legs getting weaker need emergency care now. Please don't wait.

redflag.copy.cardiac.zh: 请立即停止运动并坐下休息。如果胸口不适或呼吸困难在休息后几分钟内没有缓解，请马上拨打当地急救电话。
redflag.copy.cardiac.en: Stop now and sit down. If chest discomfort or breathlessness doesn't ease within a few minutes of rest, call emergency services.

redflag.copy.paused_banner.zh: 训练计划已暂停，等你确认看过医生后再继续。
redflag.copy.paused_banner.en: Your plan is paused until you confirm you've seen a health professional.

caution.copy.labels.substituted.zh: 已为你换成对这个部位更友好的版本。
caution.copy.labels.substituted.en: We've swapped in a version that's easier on this area.

caution.copy.labels.back_keep_moving.zh: 保持活动通常比完全休息更有帮助。今天的动作已为你调整过。
caution.copy.labels.back_keep_moving.en: Staying active usually helps more than complete rest. Today's moves have been adjusted for you.

caution.copy.labels.wrist_neutral.zh: 这个动作请握住哑铃或俯卧撑支架来做，让手腕保持笔直。
caution.copy.labels.wrist_neutral.en: Hold dumbbells or push-up handles for this one so your wrists stay straight.

caution.copy.labels.comfortable_box_heig.en: Sit down to a comfortable height.

caution.copy.labels.partial_range_or_tem.zh: 部分幅度或慢节奏自重深蹲
caution.copy.labels.partial_range_or_tem.en: Bodyweight squats with a partial range or a slow tempo.

caution.copy.labels.limited_range.en: Leg press with a limited range of motion.

caution.copy.labels.neutral_grip.en: Dumbbell bench press with a neutral grip.

caution.copy.labels.reduced_depth.zh: 减小幅度的上斜俯卧撑
caution.copy.labels.reduced_depth.en: Incline push-ups with a reduced range of motion.

older.screen.copy.intro.zh: 为了把平衡练习安排得更稳妥，想先问你 4 个简单的问题。
older.screen.copy.intro.en: To set up your balance work safely, we have 4 quick questions.

older.screen.copy.fell_in_past_12_months.zh: 过去 12 个月里，你摔倒过吗？
older.screen.copy.fell_in_past_12_months.en: Have you had a fall in the past 12 months?

older.screen.copy.afraid_of_falling.zh: 你平时会担心自己摔倒吗？

older.screen.copy.frequent_dizziness.zh: 你经常感到头晕或站不稳吗？
older.screen.copy.frequent_dizziness.en: Do you often feel dizzy or unsteady?

older.screen.copy.uses_walking_aid.zh: 你平时走路会用手杖、助行器等辅助工具吗？
older.screen.copy.uses_walking_aid.en: Do you use a stick, frame or other walking aid?

older.screen.copy.any_yes_result.zh: 谢谢。我们会从有扶手支撑的平衡练习开始，一步步来。
older.screen.copy.any_yes_result.en: Thanks. We'll start your balance work with something to hold on to and build up step by step.

older.floor.copy.before_floor_block.zh: 接下来几个动作在垫子上做。请扶着椅子慢慢下去，做完再扶着椅子慢慢起来，不用着急。
older.floor.copy.before_floor_block.en: The next few moves are on the mat. Use a chair to lower yourself down slowly, and use it again to get up when you're done. Take your time.

older.floor.copy.stand_up_slowly.zh: 起身后先站稳几秒，没有头晕再继续。
older.floor.copy.stand_up_slowly.en: Once you're up, stand still for a few seconds and carry on only if you don't feel dizzy.

older.bone.copy.zh: 骨质疏松或骨折史需要专业人士帮你判断适合的负荷。在你确认已咨询医生或物理治疗师之前，我们会先避开负重弯腰、负重扭转、大重量和跳跃类动作。
older.bone.copy.en: With osteoporosis or a past fracture, a health professional should advise on suitable loads. Until you confirm you've spoken to a doctor or physiotherapist, we'll leave out loaded bending, loaded twisting, heavy lifts and jumping.

older.stop.copy.cardiac.zh: 如果你感到胸口疼或发紧、异常气喘、头晕想晕倒，或者心跳很快、不规律，请马上停下来坐好，并尽快就医。如果休息几分钟后仍没有缓解，请立即拨打急救电话。
older.stop.copy.cardiac.en: If you feel chest pain or tightness, unusual breathlessness, dizziness or faintness, or a racing or irregular heartbeat, stop now, sit down and seek medical advice. If it doesn't ease after a few minutes' rest, call emergency services.

older.stop.copy.fall_injury.zh: 摔倒时撞到了头，或者站起来后腿不能用力，请尽快就医。训练计划先暂停，等你确认看过医生后再继续。
older.stop.copy.fall_injury.en: If you hit your head when you fell, or you can't put weight on your leg, please get medical advice soon. Your plan is paused until you confirm you've been checked.

older.stop.copy.fall_no_injury.zh: 今天的训练先到这里，好好休息。下次我们会把平衡练习调得更稳一些。
older.stop.copy.fall_no_injury.en: Let's stop here for today and rest. Next time we'll make the balance work a bit steadier.

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.0.zh: 破水，或者有液体从阴道流出
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.0.en: Your waters have broken, or fluid is leaking from your vagina

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.1.zh: 出现早产迹象（还没到预产期就有规律宫缩）

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.2.zh: 原因不明、持续不断的阴道出血
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.2.en: Unexplained vaginal bleeding that keeps happening

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.3.zh: 孕 26 周以后，医生说胎盘位置偏低（前置胎盘）

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.5.zh: 医生说你的宫颈机能不全
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.5.en: Your doctor has said your cervix is weak (incompetent cervix)

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.6.zh: 医生说宝宝生长偏慢（胎儿生长受限）
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.6.en: Your doctor has said your baby is not growing as expected

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.8.zh: 没有控制好的 1 型糖尿病、高血压或甲状腺疾病
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.8.en: Type 1 diabetes, high blood pressure or thyroid disease that isn't under control

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.9.zh: 其他严重的心脏、肺部或全身性疾病
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_list.9.en: Another serious heart, lung or whole-body condition

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.2.zh: 孕期血压升高（妊娠期高血压）
pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.2.en: High blood pressure in pregnancy (gestational hypertension)

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.3.zh: 轻到中度的心脏或肺部疾病
pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.3.en: Mild or moderate heart or lung disease

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.4.zh: 有症状的贫血（比如经常乏力、头晕）
pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.4.en: Anaemia with symptoms such as tiredness or dizziness

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.6.zh: 孕 28 周以后的双胎妊娠

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.8.en: Very low or very high body weight

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.11.en: An irregular heartbeat that hasn't been checked

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_list.12.zh: 骨骼或关节方面的限制

pregnancy.gate.copy.intro.zh: 孕期保持活动对大多数准妈妈有好处。不过有些情况需要先听医生或助产士的意见，所以先请你确认几件事。
pregnancy.gate.copy.intro.en: Staying active is good for most pregnant women. Some situations need your doctor's or midwife's advice first, so please confirm a few things.

pregnancy.gate.copy.provider_question.zh: 你的产检医生或助产士有没有说过你不适合运动？
pregnancy.gate.copy.provider_question.en: Has your doctor or midwife told you not to exercise?

pregnancy.gate.copy.prenatal_checkups_qu.zh: 你现在在定期做产检吗？
pregnancy.gate.copy.prenatal_checkups_qu.en: Are you having regular prenatal check-ups?

pregnancy.gate.copy.ask_provider.zh: 请先在产检时和医生或助产士聊聊运动的事，确认后回来告诉我们，我们再为你安排。
pregnancy.gate.copy.ask_provider.en: Please talk to your doctor or midwife about exercise at a prenatal check-up first. Come back once you have, and we’ll set up your plan.

pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_yes.zh: 根据你的回答，现在不适合由我们为你安排训练。请和你的产检医生或助产士谈一谈，听取适合你的建议。
pregnancy.gate.copy.absolute_yes.en: Based on your answers, we can't set up a training plan for you right now. Please talk to your doctor or midwife about what's right for you.

pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_yes.zh: 你提到的情况需要医生或助产士先确认你可以运动。确认后回来告诉我们，我们再为你安排。
pregnancy.gate.copy.relative_yes.en: What you've mentioned needs your doctor or midwife to confirm exercise is okay. Let us know once they have, and we'll set up your plan.

pregnancy.gate.copy.app_limit.zh: 我们无法判断你的具体情况是否适合运动。到孕 13 周和 28 周时，我们会再请你确认一次。
pregnancy.gate.copy.app_limit.en: We can't judge whether your situation is suitable for exercise. We'll ask you to confirm again at 13 and 28 weeks.

pregnancy.supine_symptom.copy.zh: 平躺时如果觉得头晕、恶心或不舒服，请马上换成侧躺或坐姿。之后我们不再安排平躺的动作。
pregnancy.supine_symptom.copy.en: If lying on your back makes you feel lightheaded, sick or unwell, switch to lying on your side or sitting up. We won't schedule lying-on-your-back moves from now on.

pregnancy.copy.hiit_deferred.zh: 本版本孕期不提供高强度间歇训练。孕前已有规律高强度训练的用户，可在医护同意下自行安排；应用内提供中等强度的有氧和力量训练。
pregnancy.copy.hiit_deferred.en: This version doesn’t offer high-intensity interval training during pregnancy. If you trained at high intensity regularly before pregnancy, you can arrange it yourself with your care provider’s approval; the app provides moderate-intensity cardio and strength training.

pregnancy.pelvic_floor.copy.zh: 今天别忘了做盆底肌练习。如果还不确定怎么做，可以请产检医生、助产士或盆底物理治疗师教你。
pregnancy.pelvic_floor.copy.en: Remember your pelvic floor exercises today. If you're not sure how to do them, ask your doctor, midwife or a pelvic health physiotherapist to show you.

pregnancy.environment.copy.heat.zh: 天气炎热或潮湿时，请选择凉爽通风的地方运动，穿宽松透气的衣服，随时补水。觉得太热或不舒服就停下来休息。
pregnancy.environment.copy.heat.en: In hot or humid weather, exercise somewhere cool and well ventilated, wear loose, breathable clothing, and drink regularly. If you feel too hot or unwell, stop and rest.

pregnancy.environment.copy.altitude.zh: 在还没适应的高海拔地区（约 1,800 米以上），请不要做剧烈运动。
pregnancy.environment.copy.altitude.en: Avoid strenuous exercise above about 1,800 metres if you’re not used to the altitude.

pregnancy.stop.copy.stop.zh: 请现在停止运动，并联系你的产检医生或助产士，如果你出现：阴道出血、有液体流出、规律的疼痛宫缩、胸痛、头晕或要晕倒、运动前就呼吸费力或休息后仍气喘、头痛、小腿疼痛或肿胀、腹痛，或者腿没力气、站不稳。
pregnancy.stop.copy.stop.en: Stop exercising now and contact your doctor or midwife if you have vaginal bleeding, fluid leaking, regular painful contractions, chest pain, dizziness or feeling faint, breathlessness before exercise or that doesn't ease afterwards, a headache, calf pain or swelling, tummy pain, or weakness that affects your balance.

pregnancy.stop.copy.chest_emergency.zh: 如果胸痛或呼吸困难在休息几分钟后仍没有缓解，请立即拨打急救电话。
pregnancy.stop.copy.chest_emergency.en: If chest pain or breathlessness doesn't ease after a few minutes' rest, call emergency services now.

pregnancy.stop.copy.paused.zh: 训练计划先暂停。联系过医生或助产士后回来确认，你的计划会一直保留。
pregnancy.stop.copy.paused.en: Your plan is paused. Once you've spoken to your doctor or midwife, come back and confirm. Your plan will be waiting.

pregnancy.copy.long_session.copy.zh: 这次训练超过 45 分钟，运动前记得吃点东西，过程中随时补水。
pregnancy.copy.long_session.copy.en: This session is over 45 minutes. Have a snack beforehand and keep sipping water as you go.

postpartum.gate.pre_check.copy.zh: 恭喜你！在正式开始训练前，请先和医生或助产士确认身体恢复情况（通常在产后 6–8 周的复查时）。在那之前，我们只安排步行、盆底肌提醒和轻柔的活动。
postpartum.gate.pre_check.copy.en: Congratulations! Before starting training, please check your recovery with your doctor or midwife, usually at your 6–8 week postnatal check. Until then, we'll keep to walking, pelvic floor reminders and gentle movement.

postpartum.gate.clearance.ask_copy.zh: 产后复查时，医生或助产士是否已经确认你可以开始运动？
postpartum.gate.clearance.ask_copy.en: At your postnatal check, did your doctor or midwife confirm you can start exercising?

postpartum.running.copy.items.1.en: Stand on one leg for 10 seconds (each side)

postpartum.running.copy.items.3.en: Jog on the spot for 1 minute

postpartum.running.copy.items.5.en: Hop on one leg 10 times (each side)

postpartum.running.copy.items.6.zh: 交替跨步跳（running man）10 次（每侧）

postpartum.running.copy.intro.zh: 想恢复跑步和跳跃？先做下面这几项自测。每一项都要做到不痛、没有下坠或沉重感、没有漏尿，才算通过。
postpartum.running.copy.intro.en: Want to get back to running and jumping? Try these self-checks first. Each one counts only if there's no pain, no heaviness or dragging, and no leaking.

postpartum.running.copy.pass.zh: 全部通过了，可以开始循序渐进地恢复跑步。大多数人在产后 3–6 个月回到跑步。
postpartum.running.copy.pass.en: You've passed every check, so you can start easing back into running. Most women return to running 3–6 months after birth.

postpartum.running.copy.fail.zh: 有一项还没通过也很正常。我们先继续力量和低冲击训练，2 周后再试。也可以请盆底物理治疗师帮你看一看。
postpartum.running.copy.fail.en: It's normal not to pass every check yet. We'll keep going with strength and low-impact work and try again in 2 weeks. A pelvic health physiotherapist can also help.

postpartum.breastfeeding.tip.zh: 如果你在哺乳，运动前先喂奶或吸奶会更舒服。运动一般不会影响奶量。运动前也记得喝水。
postpartum.breastfeeding.tip.en: If you're breastfeeding, feeding or expressing before exercise can feel more comfortable. Exercise doesn't usually affect milk supply. Remember to drink some water before you start, too.

postpartum.doming.copy.zh: 做腹部动作时如果肚子中间鼓起来，我们先换成更温和的版本，用力时记得呼气。也可以请盆底物理治疗师看一看。
postpartum.doming.copy.en: If the middle of your tummy bulges during ab exercises, we'll switch to gentler versions. Breathe out as you push. A pelvic health physiotherapist can also take a look.

postpartum.copy.warning.warning.zh: 漏尿、下坠或沉重感、盆腔或腹部疼痛，或者出血又出现或一直不停，都不是需要硬撑的情况。先暂停跑跳和大重量，并和你的全科医生、助产士或盆底物理治疗师谈一谈。
postpartum.copy.warning.warning.en: Leaking, a feeling of heaviness or dragging, pelvic or tummy pain, or bleeding that comes back or won't stop aren't things to push through. Pause running, jumping and heavy lifting, and speak to your GP, midwife or a pelvic health physiotherapist.

postpartum.copy.warning.regressed.zh: 我们已把计划调回上一阶段。等你看过专业人士，或连续 2 周没有这些症状，再继续往前。
postpartum.copy.warning.regressed.en: We've moved your plan back a stage. We'll move forward again once you've seen a professional or had 2 weeks without these symptoms.

postpartum.copy.urgent.urgent.zh: 大量出血、发烧、伤口红肿发热或渗液、小腿疼痛或肿胀、胸痛或呼吸困难，请尽快就医，不要等待。
postpartum.copy.urgent.urgent.en: Heavy bleeding, a fever, a wound that's hot, red or oozing, calf pain or swelling, chest pain or breathlessness need prompt medical care. Please don't wait.

postpartum.copy.urgent.chest_emergency.zh: 如果胸痛或呼吸困难在休息几分钟后仍没有缓解，请立即拨打急救电话。
postpartum.copy.urgent.chest_emergency.en: If chest pain or breathlessness doesn't ease after a few minutes' rest, call emergency services now.

postpartum.copy.urgent.paused.zh: 训练计划已暂停，等你确认看过医生后再继续。
postpartum.copy.urgent.paused.en: Your plan is paused until you confirm you've seen a doctor.

postpartum.pelvic_floor.copy.zh: 今天记得做盆底肌练习。如果不确定动作对不对，或者有漏尿，请找助产士或盆底物理治疗师帮忙。
postpartum.pelvic_floor.copy.en: Remember your pelvic floor exercises today. If you're not sure you're doing them right, or you have any leaking, ask a midwife or pelvic health physiotherapist.

postpartum.physio_offer.offer.zh: 产后 6 周起，可以考虑请盆底物理治疗师做一次评估，帮你更放心地恢复训练。
postpartum.physio_offer.offer.en: From 6 weeks after birth, you might consider a pelvic health physiotherapy assessment to help you return to exercise with confidence.

duration.copy.over_time.zh: 按你选择的时间，我们已经精简到最少的内容，预计需要 {est} 分钟。可以选择更长的时长，或者每周多练一次。
duration.copy.over_time.en: We've trimmed this session to the essentials for the time you chose. It should take about {est} minutes. You can pick a longer session or add another session this week.

assistant.copy.engine_noop.zh: 这次没能生成调整，点重试
assistant.copy.engine_noop.en: No adjustment was generated this time. Tap to retry.

safety.copy.parq_1.zh: 医生是否说过你有心脏问题或高血压
safety.copy.parq_1.en: Has a doctor told you that you have a heart condition or high blood pressure?

safety.copy.parq_2.zh: 休息时、日常活动时或运动时是否胸痛
safety.copy.parq_2.en: Do you have chest pain at rest, during daily activity or during exercise?

safety.copy.parq_3.zh: 过去 12 个月是否因头晕失去平衡或失去意识（因呼吸过快导致的头晕除外）
safety.copy.parq_3.en: In the last 12 months, have you lost balance because of dizziness or lost consciousness (excluding dizziness from overbreathing)?

safety.copy.parq_4.zh: 是否被诊断过其他慢性疾病
safety.copy.parq_4.en: Have you been diagnosed with another chronic condition?

safety.copy.parq_5.zh: 是否在为慢性疾病服用处方药
safety.copy.parq_5.en: Are you taking prescription medicine for a chronic condition?

safety.copy.parq_6.zh: 现在（或过去 12 个月内）是否有骨骼、关节或软组织问题，可能因活动增加而加重
safety.copy.parq_6.en: Do you currently, or have you in the last 12 months, had a bone, joint or soft tissue problem that more activity could make worse?

safety.copy.parq_7.zh: 医生是否说过你只能在医学监督下运动
safety.copy.parq_7.en: Has a doctor told you to exercise only under medical supervision?

safety.copy.local_health_consent.zh: 同意将运动前自查与孕产资料仅保存在本机
safety.copy.local_health_consent.en: Allow screening and pregnancy/postpartum information to be stored on this device

safety.copy.send_health.zh: 发送运动前自查与孕产资料

redflag.copy.question_pain_after_fall_or.zh: 跌倒或撞击后是否出现疼痛？
redflag.copy.question_pain_after_fall_or.en: Did the pain start after a fall or impact?

redflag.copy.question_cannot_bear_weight.zh: 是否无法承重或无法使用这个肢体？
redflag.copy.question_cannot_bear_weight.en: Are you unable to bear weight or use this limb?

redflag.copy.question_joint_hot_red_swol.zh: 关节是否发热、发红、肿胀，或同时发烧？
redflag.copy.question_joint_hot_red_swol.en: Is the joint hot, red or swollen, or do you also have a fever?

redflag.copy.question_locking_or_giving_.zh: 关节是否卡住或突然失去支撑？
redflag.copy.question_locking_or_giving_.en: Does the joint lock or suddenly give way?

redflag.copy.question_unexplained_night_.zh: 夜间或休息时是否有原因不明的疼痛？
redflag.copy.question_unexplained_night_.en: Do you have unexplained pain at night or at rest?

redflag.copy.question_visible_deformity.zh: 这个部位是否出现肉眼可见的变形？
redflag.copy.question_visible_deformity.en: Is there a visible deformity in this area?

redflag.copy.question_numbness_tingling_.zh: 麻木、刺痛或无力是否向手臂或腿扩散？
redflag.copy.question_numbness_tingling_.en: Is numbness, tingling or weakness spreading into an arm or leg?

redflag.copy.question_numbness_groin_or_.zh: 腹股沟或臀部周围是否发麻？
redflag.copy.question_numbness_groin_or_.en: Do you have numbness around the groin or buttocks?

redflag.copy.question_new_bladder_or_bow.zh: 是否新出现大小便控制问题？
redflag.copy.question_new_bladder_or_bow.en: Have you developed a new bladder or bowel control problem?

redflag.copy.question_progressive_leg_we.zh: 腿部无力是否在持续加重？
redflag.copy.question_progressive_leg_we.en: Is weakness in your legs getting progressively worse?

redflag.copy.question_back_pain_with_fev.zh: 腰背痛是否伴随发烧或全身不适？
redflag.copy.question_back_pain_with_fev.en: Does the back pain come with fever or feeling unwell?

redflag.copy.question_back_pain_with_can.zh: 是否有癌症病史并出现腰背痛？
redflag.copy.question_back_pain_with_can.en: Do you have back pain and a history of cancer?

redflag.copy.question_unexplained_weight.zh: 是否出现原因不明的体重下降？
redflag.copy.question_unexplained_weight.en: Have you had unexplained weight loss?

redflag.copy.question_back_pain_after_si.zh: 腰背痛是否发生在明显外伤之后？
redflag.copy.question_back_pain_after_si.en: Did the back pain start after significant trauma?

redflag.copy.question_severe_constant_pa.zh: 是否有与动作无关的持续剧烈疼痛？
redflag.copy.question_severe_constant_pa.en: Do you have severe, constant pain unrelated to movement?

redflag.copy.question_shoulder_pain_with.zh: 肩痛是否同时伴有胸痛？
redflag.copy.question_shoulder_pain_with.en: Does the shoulder pain come with chest pain?

redflag.copy.question_shoulder_pain_with.zh: 肩痛是否同时伴有气促？
redflag.copy.question_shoulder_pain_with.en: Does the shoulder pain come with breathlessness?

redflag.copy.confirm_professional_seen.zh: 我已就医，并已确认可以恢复运动
redflag.copy.confirm_professional_seen.en: I have seen a medical professional and confirmed that I can resume exercise.

redflag.copy.question_sudden_loss_of_arm.zh: 受伤后是否突然无法活动手臂？
redflag.copy.question_sudden_loss_of_arm.en: Have you suddenly been unable to move your arm after an injury?

session.copy.short_stretch_target.zh: 时间有限，这次先拉伸主要练到的部位。
session.copy.short_stretch_target.en: Time is limited, so this session stretches the main muscles you trained first.

session.copy.safety_stretch_unavailable.zh: 这次没有安排部分主项肌群的拉伸，因为当前动作库没有符合你安全条件的选项。
session.copy.safety_stretch_unavailable.en: Some main muscle groups are not stretched this time because the current exercise library has no options that meet your safety requirements.

session.copy.short_health_shares.zh: 本次实际安排：抗阻 {resistance}%、有氧 {aerobic}%。默认目标是两者各占45%–55%，这份短课尚未达到该占比。
session.copy.short_health_shares.en: Actual allocation: resistance {resistance}%, aerobic {aerobic}%. The default target is 45%–55% for each; this short plan has not reached that balance.

engine.copy.target_volume.zh: 有几个部位本周练得偏少。时间允许的话，加一天或每次多练 10 分钟会更均衡。
engine.copy.target_volume.en: A few muscle groups get less work than recommended this week. If you have time, adding a day or 10 more minutes per session would balance things out.

engine.copy.target_aerobic.zh: 本周的有氧时间还不够。平时多走走也算数，每次 10 分钟就有帮助。
engine.copy.target_aerobic.en: Cardio time is below this week’s target. Everyday walking counts too, and even 10 minutes at a time helps.

engine.copy.target_coverage.zh: 受时间或器械所限，有些动作类型这周没能安排上。
engine.copy.target_coverage.en: Because of time or equipment limits, some movement types aren’t covered this week.

engine.copy.target_spacing.zh: 有两次力量训练离得比较近。如果练完还很酸，可以把其中一次换成轻松活动。
engine.copy.target_spacing.en: Two strength sessions are close together. If you’re still sore, swap one for some light activity.

engine.copy.target_balance.zh: 可训练的日子少于 3 天，所以每次训练都尽量安排了平衡练习。
engine.copy.target_balance.en: With fewer than 3 training days, we’ve included balance practice in each session where possible.

engine.copy.environment_limited.zh: 当前条件下没有可安排的动作，请修改场地条件
engine.copy.environment_limited.en: No exercises can be arranged under the current conditions. Please update your space settings.

engine.copy.environment_balance.zh: 平衡练习需要一个能扶的地方，比如墙、椅背或桌边。家里有的话，点这里告诉芽芽，就能把平衡练习加回来。
engine.copy.environment_balance.en: Balance practice needs something to hold on to, like a wall, chair back or table edge. If you have one, tap here to let Yaya know and we’ll add balance practice back in.

engine.copy.environment_type.zh: 你当前的器械或场地下，暂时安排不了「{类型}」。修改器械或场地后可以加回来。
engine.copy.environment_type.en: With your current equipment or space, we can’t include {type} yet. Update your equipment or space to add it back.

session.copy.intentional_short.zh: 这次安排比你预留的时间短，先按这份练就好。
session.copy.intentional_short.en: This session is shorter than the time you set aside. Just follow this plan for now.
